title: 日常生活与社交闲聊
goal: 能用一两句话协调安排、处理购物出行小事并回应朋友。
basis: 参照 CEFR 2020 口语互动中的信息交换、日常交往及获取商品与服务。例句与提示为原创。

units.title: 约时间、改计划和发出邀请
units.goal: 用清楚而不生硬的方式约人，遇到变动也能接着谈。

cards.en: Are you up for grabbing a bite after work?
cards.zh: 下班后想不想一起吃点东西？
cards.trigger_context: 下班后临时邀请同事吃点东西。
cards.disambiguator: 你在主动邀请对方参加一项轻松的活动，语气偏随意。
cards.usage_boundary: for 后面可以接活动名称或动名词，例如 a hike 或 grabbing a bite。
cards.feynman_hook: 我想把一个好玩的提议抛给你，看看你愿不愿意一起。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 约朋友周六一起徒步。
cards.transfer_example_en: Are you up for a hike on Saturday?

cards.en: Do you feel like going for a walk?
cards.zh: 你想不想出门散个步？
cards.trigger_context: 天气不错，问朋友现在想不想出门走走。
cards.disambiguator: 询问当下心情或意愿。
cards.feynman_hook: 眼下有什么想做的，你不用先考虑长期安排。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 问家人今晚想不想做饭。
cards.transfer_example_en: Do you feel like cooking tonight?

cards.en: I'm free after four if you want to meet up.
cards.zh: 如果想见面，我四点后有空。
cards.trigger_context: 下午先要开会，告诉朋友会议后能见。
cards.disambiguator: 给出你什么时候开始有空，具体见面时间还没定。
cards.usage_boundary: after 后接时刻或活动，例如 after four 或 after class。
cards.feynman_hook: 我先报出最早能见面的时刻，让你在这之后挑。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 告诉维修师傅下班后可以上门。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'm free after six if you need to come by.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I__] [f___] [a____] four if you want to meet up.

cards.en: I can meet at seven. Does that work for you?
cards.zh: 我可以七点见。你方便吗？
cards.trigger_context: 你提议晚一点碰面，核对对方安排。
cards.disambiguator: 已经摆出一项具体安排，想知道它是否合对方的实际需要。
cards.usage_boundary: that 指前一句那个时间或办法，先把提议说清楚再问。
cards.feynman_hook: 这是个初步提议，我想核对你的日程也能配合。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 确认把文件发共享盘是否可行。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'll put it in the shared folder. Does that work for you?

cards.en: How does Friday sound for dinner?
cards.zh: 周五一起吃晚饭怎么样？
cards.trigger_context: 这周还没约定见面的日期，你先提周五。
cards.disambiguator: 双方还在商量日子，你先提出一个让对方评价。
cards.usage_boundary: 用 How does + 日期或时间 + sound? 提出新选项，例如 How does Tuesday sound?。
cards.feynman_hook: 这个星期五先放到桌上，听听你觉得怎么样。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 用周五提议朋友来帮忙搬家。
cards.transfer_example_en: How does Friday sound for moving the boxes?

cards.en: Let's pencil it in for Sunday and confirm tomorrow.
cards.zh: 我们先暂定周日，明天再确认。
cards.trigger_context: 约周日喝咖啡，但还得看一方的班表。
cards.disambiguator: 留个暂定档期。
cards.feynman_hook: 我先在日历上写个可以擦掉的日期。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 先保留会议时间，等房间敲定。
cards.transfer_example_en: We can pencil it in for two while I check if the room is free.
cards.cloze_prompt: Let's [p_____] [i_] [i_] for Sunday and confirm tomorrow.

cards.en: The café by the bridge? Great, see you there.
cards.zh: 桥边那家咖啡馆？好，那儿见。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友刚发来见面的地点，你确认会到。
cards.disambiguator: 见面地点和参与意愿已经明确，用一句轻松的收尾表示会到。
cards.usage_boundary: there 要指双方已知的地点，可用在对话或消息的结尾。
cards.feynman_hook: 地方说好了，剩下就是到了以后见。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 回复朋友发来的展馆地址。
cards.transfer_example_en: Thanks for the address. See you there.
cards.cloze_prompt: The café by the bridge? Great, [s__] [y__] [t____].

cards.en: I'm running a little late. I'll be there in ten minutes.
cards.zh: 我会晚一点，十分钟后到。
cards.trigger_context: 公交堵在路上，你发消息提醒等你的人。
cards.disambiguator: 说人正在晚点。
cards.usage_boundary: 最好补个大概到达时间。
cards.feynman_hook: 我已经在路上了，只是会比说好的时间晚一点。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 告诉牙医前台自己快到但比约定晚几分钟。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'm running a little late, but I'm just around the corner.
cards.cloze_prompt: I'm [r______] [a_] [l_____] [l___]. I'll be there in ten minutes.

cards.en: Sorry, something came up and I can't make it tonight.
cards.zh: 抱歉，临时有点事，我今晚去不了了。
cards.trigger_context: 本来答应去看电影，临时有事去不了。
cards.disambiguator: 交代突发变故。
cards.feynman_hook: 日程里突然冒出件别的事，原来约好的安排得改。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 告诉预约的教练自己得改时间。
cards.transfer_example_en: Something came up. Could we move the lesson to next week?
cards.cloze_prompt: Sorry, [s________] [c___] [u_] and I can't make it tonight.

cards.en: Can I take a rain check? I have to work late tonight.
cards.zh: 能改天再约吗？我今晚得加班。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友邀请你今晚吃饭，你有事且想改天。
cards.disambiguator: 婉拒眼前这一次，同时给双方保留以后再约的余地。
cards.usage_boundary: 可用 take a rain check on + 活动，也可先谢过邀请，再问 Can I take a rain check?。
cards.feynman_hook: 现在这次去不成，我想把邀请留到改天接受。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 今天不去打球，表示下次还想去。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'll take a rain check on tennis. My knee's a bit sore.
cards.cloze_prompt: Can I [t___] [a_] [r___] [c____]? I have to work late tonight.

cards.en: Let's make it another day when you're feeling better.
cards.zh: 等你好些了，我们改天再约吧。
cards.trigger_context: 有朋友临时不舒服，大家决定换个日期。
cards.disambiguator: 明确换日期。
cards.usage_boundary: 当次安排不用勉强继续。
cards.feynman_hook: 今天条件不合适，我们另外找一天办同一件事。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 发现街道封闭，改日看房。
cards.transfer_example_en: The road's closed today, so let's make it another day.

cards.en: Could we push it back by half an hour?
cards.zh: 能把时间往后推半小时吗？
cards.trigger_context: 会议撞上另一项安排，你希望晚半小时。
cards.disambiguator: 改到更晚时间。
cards.feynman_hook: 把日历里的那块时间往未来推一点。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 请摄影师把验片日期延到下周。
cards.transfer_example_en: Can we push it back to next Tuesday?
cards.cloze_prompt: Could we [p___] [i_] [b___] by half an hour?

cards.en: It's meant to rain later. Can we move it up to four?
cards.zh: 预报晚点下雨。能提前到四点吗？
cards.trigger_context: 晚上预报有雨，问能否早点打球。
cards.disambiguator: 把既定安排提前。
cards.feynman_hook: 把原来排得靠后的活动移到更早的时刻。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 希望面试提前到上午。
cards.transfer_example_en: Could we move it up to ten in the morning?
cards.cloze_prompt: It's meant to rain later. Can we [m___] [i_] [u_] to four?

cards.en: I can fit you in at three if you're nearby.
cards.zh: 如果你就在附近，我可以给你安排三点。
cards.trigger_context: 当天大部分预约已满，店员还能安排一个时段。
cards.disambiguator: 给某个人插入已有日程。
cards.feynman_hook: 我的时间表很满，不过中间还能给你腾出一个位置。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 教练发现午休前有空，安排补课。
cards.transfer_example_en: I can fit you in just before lunch on Thursday.
cards.cloze_prompt: I can [f__] [y__] [i_] at three if you're nearby.

cards.en: Thanks for asking, but I'll pass this time.
cards.zh: 谢谢问我，这次我先不点。
cards.trigger_context: 同事问要不要一起订奶茶，你今天不想喝。
cards.disambiguator: 礼貌放弃这一次。
cards.feynman_hook: 谢谢你也叫上我，这回我就先不参加了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 朋友邀请你参加周末自驾，你这周想休息。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'll pass this time. I could use a quiet weekend.

cards.en: A picnic on Sunday? Count me in.
cards.zh: 周日野餐？算我一个。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友说周末组织野餐，你爽快答应。
cards.disambiguator: 明确表示参加。
cards.feynman_hook: 数参加人数时把我也算上，我愿意去。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 同事问谁愿意参加午休跑步。
cards.transfer_example_en: If you're going for a run at lunch, count me in.

cards.en: I'm easy. Both places look good.
cards.zh: 我都可以。两家看起来都不错。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友在两家餐馆间难选，你对两家都满意。
cards.disambiguator: 英式口语中表达无特别偏好。
cards.feynman_hook: 你出的几个选项我都行，我这边没有特别要选的。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 朋友问你坐地铁还是走路。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'm easy. We can walk if you like.

cards.en: Morning or afternoon, whatever works for you.
cards.zh: 上午下午都行，按你方便的来。
cards.trigger_context: 两种送货时间对你都行，交给对方选。
cards.disambiguator: 把选择交给对方。
cards.usage_boundary: 温和说出避免显得不耐烦。
cards.feynman_hook: 哪一种最方便你就定哪一种，我能配合。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 线上或线下见面都行，随同事选择。
cards.transfer_example_en: We can meet online or in person, whatever works for you.

cards.target_chunk: I'll keep you in the loop
cards.chunk_in_sentence: I'll keep you in the loop
cards.en: I'll keep you in the loop if the venue changes.
cards.zh: 如果场地变了，我会通知你。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友没法加入筹备群，希望你随时告诉他变化。
cards.disambiguator: 承诺让对方继续知情。
cards.feynman_hook: 你现在不在讨论里，有变化我会接着告诉你。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 同事出差，承诺告诉他采购进展。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'll keep you in the loop while you're away.

cards.en: We should show up early to get through security.
cards.zh: 我们该早点到，好留时间过安检。
cards.trigger_context: 入场要安检，你提议比约定早到。
cards.disambiguator: 关注人真正到现场的时间，常见于安检、排队或抢位置。
cards.usage_boundary: 可接 to + 动词说明提早抵达的目的，也可用 for + 活动说为哪场活动早到。
cards.feynman_hook: 不要掐着开场时间到，提前一会儿进场更从容。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 提醒朋友排队买限量糕点要早到。
cards.transfer_example_en: You'll need to show up early if you want one of those pies.
cards.cloze_prompt: We should [s___] [u_] [e____] to get through security.

units.title: 点餐、购物与问路
units.goal: 问清价格、限制和路线，遇到问题能开口处理。

cards.en: Could I get an oat latte, please?
cards.zh: 能给我来一杯燕麦拿铁吗？
cards.trigger_context: 在咖啡店点一杯燕麦拿铁。
cards.disambiguator: 用于点餐或请求物品。
cards.feynman_hook: 我想点这一样，请把它给我一份。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 向前台要一张地图。
cards.transfer_example_en: Could I get a map of the neighbourhood?

cards.en: Is that for here or to go?
cards.zh: 您是在这儿吃还是带走？
cards.trigger_context: 你是店员，要确认顾客是否堂食。
cards.disambiguator: 询问顾客的用餐方式，两个答案决定装盘还是打包。
cards.usage_boundary: 在北美柜台常省略完整问句。英国也常听见 eat in or take away。
cards.feynman_hook: 这份餐现在是在座位上吃，还是我得打包给你？。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 重复确认顾客点的三明治。
cards.transfer_example_en: One chicken sandwich. For here or to go?

cards.en: Could I have the dressing on the side?
cards.zh: 能把沙拉酱单独放吗？
cards.trigger_context: 你点沙拉，希望沙拉酱单独给。
cards.disambiguator: 请求配料分装。
cards.feynman_hook: 调料给我另外放，我自己决定放多少。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 要薯条和酱汁，但希望酱汁分开。
cards.transfer_example_en: Can you put the sauce on the side?

cards.en: What comes with the grilled chicken?
cards.zh: 烤鸡配些什么？
cards.trigger_context: 菜单只写了主菜，你想了解套餐包含什么。
cards.disambiguator: 想了解价内自带的配菜、服务或物品。
cards.usage_boundary: with 后接菜品或套餐，例如 What comes with the chicken?。
cards.feynman_hook: 光看主菜名字还不够，我想知道这份餐里本来配什么。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 问酒店房间默认配套服务。
cards.transfer_example_en: What comes with the standard room?

cards.en: Sorry, we're out of blueberry muffins.
cards.zh: 抱歉，蓝莓松饼卖完了。
cards.trigger_context: 客人要点蓝莓松饼，可是刚售罄。
cards.disambiguator: 表示眼下没有存货。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚才那份已经没货了，今天可能得换点别的。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 合租厨房发现牛奶用完。
cards.transfer_example_en: We're out of milk. Can you pick some up?

cards.en: Do you have these in a different size?
cards.zh: 这款有别的尺码吗？
cards.trigger_context: 试穿鞋偏紧，问是否有别的尺码。
cards.disambiguator: 款式已经选好，眼下只想看其他尺寸。
cards.usage_boundary: 可接更具体的要求，如 in a larger size。衣服尺码也常问 Do you have this in a medium?。
cards.feynman_hook: 我还是想要刚才那一款，请把它换个大小试试。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 买照片相框，问有没有其他大小。
cards.transfer_example_en: Could I get this frame in a different size?

cards.en: I like this coat. Can I try it on?
cards.zh: 我喜欢这件外套。可以试穿吗？
cards.trigger_context: 喜欢一件外套，想先穿上看看。
cards.disambiguator: 用于衣物配饰。
cards.usage_boundary: 代词通常放在 try 和 on 之间。
cards.feynman_hook: 先穿到身上走两步，才知道是不是真的合适。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 买表前问店员能不能戴一下。
cards.transfer_example_en: Could I try it on before I buy it?
cards.cloze_prompt: I like this coat. Can I [t__] [i_] [o_]?

cards.en: Thanks, I'm just looking at the moment.
cards.zh: 谢谢，我目前先随便看看。
cards.trigger_context: 逛店时店员上来问要不要帮忙。
cards.disambiguator: 礼貌表示暂时自己逛。
cards.feynman_hook: 现在想一个人逛逛，有问题我再找你。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 在二手家具店婉拒店员立即介绍。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'm just looking, but I'll ask if I need anything.

cards.en: I like the table, but it's a little over budget.
cards.zh: 我喜欢这张桌子，但有点超预算。
cards.trigger_context: 喜欢一张桌子，但是超出了愿意花的价钱。
cards.disambiguator: 说相对于自己的预算高。
cards.feynman_hook: 东西本身我喜欢，只是它比我原来备的钱贵一点。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 合租看房时坦白房租略贵。
cards.transfer_example_en: That flat is a little over budget for us.
cards.cloze_prompt: I like the table, but it's [a_] [l_____] [o___] [b_____].

cards.en: Could you check the price on this, please?
cards.zh: 能帮我查一下这个的价格吗？
cards.trigger_context: 标牌价和收银价不同，想现场核对。
cards.disambiguator: 需要店员查询价格、存货或订单等可以核实的细节。
cards.usage_boundary: check 后可接要核实的对象，或用 if / whether 引出要确认的情况。
cards.feynman_hook: 我手里的信息和你们显示的有出入，请帮我核对一下。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 请工作人员查另一个门店有没有存货。
cards.transfer_example_en: Could you check if the other branch has any in stock?

cards.en: Can I get a refund? The kettle doesn't switch on.
cards.zh: 我能退款吗？这烧水壶打不开。
cards.trigger_context: 买回去发现设备坏了，拿着收据去店里。
cards.disambiguator: 询问退钱。
cards.feynman_hook: 这次我想把钱退回来，先问能不能办理。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 活动取消后问能否退票款。
cards.transfer_example_en: Can I get a refund if the show is cancelled?

cards.en: Could we split the bill between the three of us?
cards.zh: 我们三个人能分开结账吗？
cards.trigger_context: 朋友聚餐后希望各人自行付款。
cards.disambiguator: 这种问法提出分账的请求，具体怎么分要看下一句。
cards.usage_boundary: 想均摊可加 equally。想各付各的，可说明 pay separately 或各自点的菜。
cards.feynman_hook: 这顿饭大家分开付，我想跟服务员说清楚。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 两人想分别用各自的卡付款。
cards.transfer_example_en: Could we split the bill and pay on separate cards?

cards.en: Here's five. Keep the change.
cards.zh: 给你五块，零钱不用找了。
cards.trigger_context: 用现金买咖啡，想把小额找零留给店员。
cards.disambiguator: 付款已超过应付金额，结账时把差额留给对方。
cards.usage_boundary: 用于付现金后有零钱可找时。刷卡或用手机付款时需要单独说给小费。
cards.feynman_hook: 这点零钱就留给你这个收款人好了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 坐出租车后留下找零。
cards.transfer_example_en: Here you go. You can keep the change.

cards.en: Where can I catch the airport bus?
cards.zh: 我在哪儿能坐到机场巴士？
cards.trigger_context: 到陌生市区后要找去机场的巴士站。
cards.disambiguator: 问搭乘公共交通的地点。
cards.feynman_hook: 我要找的是上这班车的站点。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 在车站找去球场的电车。
cards.transfer_example_en: Where can I catch the tram to the stadium?

cards.en: I'd like to visit the museum. Is it within walking distance?
cards.zh: 我想去博物馆。能走过去吗？
cards.trigger_context: 问住处离博物馆近不近，想步行往返。
cards.disambiguator: 问步行是否现实。
cards.feynman_hook: 我想靠两条腿走到那儿，先问路线会不会太远。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 向房东问最近的超市能否步行到达。
cards.transfer_example_en: Is it within walking distance from the flat?
cards.cloze_prompt: I'd like to visit the museum. [I_] [i_] [w_____] [w______] [d_______]?

cards.en: Get off at the library and cross the road.
cards.zh: 在图书馆站下车，再过马路。
cards.trigger_context: 问路时，告诉游客到图书馆站下车。
cards.disambiguator: 问路时交代某人在沿途哪个点下车。
cards.usage_boundary: at 后接站点或地标。get off 常用于公交、火车、地铁等交通工具。
cards.feynman_hook: 坐车时数到这个站，就该准备下车了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 提醒朋友到下一站下地铁。
cards.transfer_example_en: We need to get off at the next stop.
cards.cloze_prompt: [G__] [o__] [a_] the library and cross the road.

cards.en: The pharmacy is right around the corner.
cards.zh: 药店就在拐角附近。
cards.trigger_context: 要描述药店离当前街角几步路。
cards.disambiguator: 这里指位置很近。
cards.feynman_hook: 就几步路，转过去差不多就看见了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 告诉朋友自己的新办公室近在附近。
cards.transfer_example_en: My new office is right around the corner.

cards.en: Head straight down this street until you reach the bridge.
cards.zh: 沿这条街一直走到桥边。
cards.trigger_context: 你给游客指路，先让他沿这条街走。
cards.disambiguator: 给出方向。
cards.usage_boundary: 沿指定街道继续走一段。
cards.feynman_hook: 沿这条路保持方向，看到我说的地标再转弯。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 给访客指明沿走廊走到最后一扇门。
cards.transfer_example_en: Head straight down the hall to the last door.
cards.cloze_prompt: [H___] [s_______] [d___] this street until you reach the bridge.

cards.en: I'd like a one-way ticket to the city centre.
cards.zh: 我想买一张去市中心的单程票。
cards.trigger_context: 你去市中心，回程准备跟朋友坐车。
cards.disambiguator: 去程和回程分开买，现在只需要去程。
cards.usage_boundary: 买票时可接 to 加目的地。英国铁路售票也常用 a single。
cards.feynman_hook: 我只买去那里的这一程，回来另作安排。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 预订不含回程的去机场车票。
cards.transfer_example_en: Can I book a one-way ticket to the airport?
cards.cloze_prompt: I'd like [a_] [o__]-[w__] [t_____] to the city centre.

cards.en: Could you hold the lift? My hands are full.
cards.zh: 能帮我按着电梯门吗？我手上拿满了东西。
cards.trigger_context: 双手拎着购物袋，想请人按住电梯门。
cards.disambiguator: 英式 lift 指电梯。
cards.usage_boundary: 美式常说 hold the elevator。
cards.feynman_hook: 先别让电梯门关上，我手里的东西还没拿完。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 搬箱子上楼，请邻居帮忙等电梯。
cards.transfer_example_en: Could you hold the lift while I grab the last box?
cards.cloze_prompt: Could you [h___] [t__] [l___]? My hands are full.

units.title: 闲聊、关心与处理小尴尬
units.goal: 自然开启或延续闲聊，表达共情和界限。

cards.en: It's been months. How have you been?
cards.zh: 都好几个月没见了。你最近怎么样？
cards.trigger_context: 碰见一位几个月没见的同学。
cards.disambiguator: 隔了一段时间重新见到或联系某人，重点是那段时间的近况。
cards.usage_boundary: since 后可加上次见面或某件事。熟人短暂重逢也可以单独问。
cards.feynman_hook: 这一阵子没见，我想听听你近来过得怎么样。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 给许久没联系的旧同事打电话。
cards.transfer_example_en: How have you been since you changed jobs?

cards.en: Good to see you. I'm glad you could make it.
cards.zh: 见到你真好。很高兴你能来。
cards.trigger_context: 聚会刚到，见到一位认识的朋友。
cards.disambiguator: 见面时表达高兴。
cards.feynman_hook: 看见你来了，我是真的挺开心。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 到办公室见到返岗同事。
cards.transfer_example_en: Good to see you back at work.
cards.cloze_prompt: [G___] [t_] [s__] [y__]. I'm glad you could make it.

cards.en: We should catch up sometime. Are you still living nearby?
cards.zh: 有空该聚聚。你还住在附近吗？
cards.trigger_context: 偶遇旧同事又赶时间，想另约下次。
cards.disambiguator: 有段时间没好好聊过，此刻先约个以后见面的意向。
cards.usage_boundary: 常用在碰面或通话的收尾，sometime 暂留时间，确定以后可以补具体日期。
cards.feynman_hook: 今天来不及聊，找个日子坐下来把近况补一补。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 聚会结束和老邻居道别约再聊。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let's catch up sometime when things are less busy.
cards.cloze_prompt: We should [c____] [u_] [s_______]. Are you still living nearby?

cards.en: Hey, how's it going?
cards.zh: 嗨，最近怎么样？
cards.trigger_context: 早晨遇见熟悉的店员，轻松打个招呼。
cards.disambiguator: 轻量问候。
cards.feynman_hook: 我先轻松问一声，听你想聊到什么程度。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 看见队友在赛前热身，打声招呼。
cards.transfer_example_en: How's it going? Ready for the game?

cards.target_chunk: what have you been up to
cards.chunk_in_sentence: what have you been up to
cards.en: What have you been up to since the course ended?
cards.zh: 课程结束后你最近在忙些什么？
cards.trigger_context: 一阵子没跟朋友聊，想听他最近的活动。
cards.disambiguator: 关注对方最近做了什么，适合与熟人打开话题。
cards.usage_boundary: 可加 lately 或 since last time，把近期范围说具体。
cards.feynman_hook: 上次见面以后，你这段时间都在忙哪些事？。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 问暑假很久没见的同学都做了什么。
cards.transfer_example_en: What have you been up to this summer?

cards.en: That sounds rough. Have you had any time to rest?
cards.zh: 听着真不容易。你有时间休息吗？
cards.trigger_context: 朋友说他上周连着上了三个夜班。
cards.disambiguator: 承认对方经历很辛苦。
cards.feynman_hook: 你遇到的事听起来真不好熬，我先听你多说一点。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 同事讲述航班取消后在机场过夜。
cards.transfer_example_en: That sounds rough. Were you able to sleep at all?
cards.cloze_prompt: [T___] [s_____] [r____]. Have you had any time to rest?

cards.en: I know the feeling. Packing always takes me twice as long as I expect.
cards.zh: 我懂那种感觉。我收拾行李总比预计多花一倍时间。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友说搬家前有太多东西要收拾，你也经历过。
cards.disambiguator: 表达有类似体会。
cards.usage_boundary: 不宣称知道对方全部感受。
cards.feynman_hook: 我也经历过差不多的感受，听得懂你在说什么。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 朋友说上台前紧张到手抖。
cards.transfer_example_en: I know the feeling. My hands shake before presentations too.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [k___] [t__] [f______]. Packing always takes me twice as long as I expect.

cards.en: They found the cat? That's a relief.
cards.zh: 猫找到了？这下放心了。
cards.trigger_context: 走失的猫找到了，你终于松了口气。
cards.disambiguator: 担心已有明确缓解，回应重点是现在终于能放心。
cards.usage_boundary: 常直接回应让人安心的消息，也可说 What a relief!。
cards.feynman_hook: 先前心里悬着一件事，听到这个结果才松口气。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 得知体检结果一切正常。
cards.transfer_example_en: That's a relief. I was worried about the test results.

cards.en: Good for you! Five kilometres is a big step.
cards.zh: 真替你高兴！跑完五公里是很大一步。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友坚持锻炼，完成第一次五公里跑。
cards.disambiguator: 真诚祝贺努力或进展。
cards.feynman_hook: 你为这事付出了力气，听说有成果我替你高兴。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 为朋友第一次在会议上全程用英语发言而高兴。
cards.transfer_example_en: Good for you! Speaking up in English takes courage.
cards.cloze_prompt: [G___] [f__] [y__]! Five kilometres is a big step.

cards.en: You made my day with that card.
cards.zh: 收到你那张卡片，我今天特别开心。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友送了一张自己画的卡片，你非常高兴。
cards.disambiguator: 说一件事让整天心情变好。
cards.feynman_hook: 今天本来很普通，你做的这件事让我一直很开心。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 收到好久不见的朋友发来的视频。
cards.transfer_example_en: You made my day with that video.

cards.en: Thanks for driving me home. I really appreciate it.
cards.zh: 谢谢你开车送我回家，我真的很感谢。
cards.trigger_context: 雨天对方主动开车送你回家。
cards.disambiguator: 感谢某一次具体帮助。
cards.feynman_hook: 这份具体的帮忙对我有用，我想让你知道我感激。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 感谢同事提前替你交了文件。
cards.transfer_example_en: Thanks for dropping off the forms. I really appreciate it.

cards.en: Sorry about that. I didn't see your foot.
cards.zh: 不好意思，我没看到你的脚。
cards.trigger_context: 你不小心踩了旁人鞋子，想当下道歉。
cards.disambiguator: 事情刚发生，适合及时回应撞到人、拿错东西等小意外。
cards.usage_boundary: that 指双方都知道的小事故。需要明确承担的错误可直接说出自己做错了什么。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚才那一小下给你添麻烦了，我当面说声抱歉。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说错朋友的名字，发现后立即道歉。
cards.transfer_example_en: Sorry about that. I mixed up your names.

cards.en: No worries. I just got here myself.
cards.zh: 没事儿，我自己也刚到。
cards.trigger_context: 别人道歉迟到几分钟，你并不介意。
cards.disambiguator: 轻松接受道歉或回应感谢。
cards.feynman_hook: 我没有为这个小插曲介意，你可以放下了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 朋友感谢你帮他带了一瓶水。
cards.transfer_example_en: No worries. I was going to the shop anyway.

cards.en: Don't take it personally. She had the same concern about my idea.
cards.zh: 别往心里去。她对我的点子也有同样的顾虑。
cards.trigger_context: 同事批评提案，你想安慰把批评当成针对自己的人。
cards.disambiguator: 指出评价对象是事情。
cards.feynman_hook: 那句话说的是当下的事，你不用把它当成对整个人的评价。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 球队教练调阵让朋友坐替补，安慰他。
cards.transfer_example_en: Don't take it personally. The coach is trying a different lineup.
cards.cloze_prompt: [D____] [t___] [i_] [p_________]. She had the same concern about my idea.

cards.en: I'd rather not share the photo without asking her first.
cards.zh: 没先问过她的话，我不太想转发照片。
cards.trigger_context: 有人请你转发一张包含别人隐私的照片。
cards.disambiguator: 温和而明确地表示不愿意。
cards.feynman_hook: 我希望这件事就免了，仍想把话说得客气一点。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 婉拒在店里留下自己的电话号码。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'd rather not leave my phone number, if that's okay.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I__] [r_____] [n__] share the photo without asking her first.

cards.en: I'm not really into boxing, but I could meet you afterwards.
cards.zh: 我不太喜欢拳击，不过结束后可以碰面。
cards.trigger_context: 新朋友问你周末想不想去看拳击。
cards.disambiguator: 说自己平常没这个兴趣。
cards.feynman_hook: 这一直不是我的兴趣，咱们可以聊点别的。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 同事提议去玩桌游，你不太喜欢策略类。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'm not really into strategy games, but I like word games.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I__] [n__] [r_____] [i___] boxing, but I could meet you afterwards.

cards.en: I'm happy to help you carry that upstairs.
cards.zh: 我乐意帮你把那个搬上楼。
cards.trigger_context: 邻居想搬一件小家具，你愿意搭把手。
cards.disambiguator: 真诚表示愿意帮。
cards.feynman_hook: 这件忙我愿意搭把手，可以说说怎么配合。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 愿意替同事读一遍邮件草稿。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'm happy to help you check the email before it goes out.

cards.target_chunk: let me know if you need
cards.chunk_in_sentence: let me know if you need
cards.en: Let me know if you need someone to practise with.
cards.zh: 如果需要人陪练，就告诉我。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友要准备面试，你可以陪他练。
cards.disambiguator: 给对方打开求助入口。
cards.feynman_hook: 以后遇到需要我帮忙的地方，你随时可以开口。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 朋友搬家时可借你的工具。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let me know if you need any tools for the move.

cards.en: I'm sorry I didn't call. It slipped my mind.
cards.zh: 对不起我没打电话，我一时给忘了。
cards.trigger_context: 本来答应给朋友回电话，忙完才想起来。
cards.disambiguator: 说自己无意忘记某件事。
cards.feynman_hook: 我原来是记着的，忙起来那一下没想起来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 迟了才发上周答应的资料。
cards.transfer_example_en: It slipped my mind, but I'll send the file now.

cards.target_chunk: don't be too hard on yourself
cards.chunk_in_sentence: don't be too hard on yourself
cards.en: Don't be too hard on yourself. It was your first time making it.
cards.zh: 别对自己太苛刻，你第一次做这道菜。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友做砸了一道新菜，很懊恼。
cards.disambiguator: 对方把一次失误看得过于严重，需要先缓解自责。
cards.usage_boundary: 多用于朋友之间的安慰，接上具体的改善机会会比单独一句更贴心。
cards.feynman_hook: 你这次确实有一处做得不顺，先给自己留一点练习余地。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 朋友口试时某一句卡住，考完一直过意不去。
cards.transfer_example_en: Don't be too hard on yourself. One pause doesn't ruin the whole interview.
cards.cloze_prompt: [D____] [b_] [t__] [h___] [o_] [y_______]. It was your first time making it.
